selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall on node1 permits SSH and TCP 8080
selected_evidence.summary: iptables-save output on node1 shows ACCEPT rules for loopback, ESTABLISHED/RELATED, tcp/22, tcp/8080; live test from node2 shows SSH succeeds and curl to 8080 returns http_code=200
curl to node1 port 9999 (unrelated, not opened) fails with 'No route to host', proving the REJECT catch-all rule is active

selected_evidence.requirement: Firewall implemented and applied using Ansible
selected_evidence.summary: Playbook /root/ansible/host-firewall.yml written on control node node2 and executed via ansible-playbook against node1; second run shows firewall tasks as 'ok' confirming idempotent, Ansible-managed state

Pre-restart boot_id captured (6d15d99d...), node1 rebooted, post-restart boot_id changed (cfef943e...), and iptables/ip6tables rules plus functional SSH/8080-allow/9999-reject behavior were automatically restored without any reconfiguration

Baseline (boot_id 6d15d99d, sshd/iptables started, empty-then-populated ruleset) -> reboot ack -> changed boot_id (cfef943e) -> recovered iptables rules, sshd, and verified SSH/8080/9999 behavior post-restart

Baseline (boot_id 416c5cf5, sshd socket listening on :22, ansible/playbook files present) -> systemctl reboot ack -> changed boot_id (4ce6264c) -> confirmed ansible functional and SSH connectivity from node2 to node1 restored post-restart

iptables_name=${SVCNAME}
case "$iptables_name" in
	iptables|ip6tables) ;;
	*) iptables_name="iptables" ;;
esac

iptables_bin="/usr/sbin/${iptables_name}"

		iptables_save="${IPTABLES_SAVE}"

		sysctl_ipfwd=net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding

	iptables_bin="ip netns exec $netns $iptables_bin"

commands.command:
cat > /root/ansible/host-firewall.yml <<'PLAYBOOK_EOF'
---
- name: Configure persistent host firewall on node1 (SSH + 8080 only)
  hosts: firewall_nodes
  become: false
  gather_facts: true

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure iptables and ip6tables packages are installed
      community.general.apk:
        name:
          - iptables
          - ip6tables
        state: present
        update_cache: true

    - name: Flush existing IPv4 filter rules to start from a known state
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        table: filter
        chain: "{{ item }}"
        flush: true
      loop:
        - INPUT
        - FORWARD
        - OUTPUT

    - name: Allow loopback traffic
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        in_interface: lo
        jump: ACCEPT
        comment: "Allow loopback"

    - name: Allow established and related inbound connections
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        ctstate: ESTABLISHED,RELATED
        jump: ACCEPT
        comment: "Allow established/related"

    - name: Allow inbound SSH (tcp/22)
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        protocol: tcp
        destination_port: "22"
        ctstate: NEW
        jump: ACCEPT
        comment: "Allow SSH"

    - name: Allow inbound application traffic (tcp/8080)
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        protocol: tcp
        destination_port: "8080"
        ctstate: NEW
        jump: ACCEPT
        comment: "Allow app 8080"

    - name: Reject all other inbound traffic
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        jump: REJECT
        reject_with: icmp-host-prohibited
        comment: "Reject unrelated inbound"

    - name: Ensure IPv6 input policy also rejects unrelated inbound (loopback + established only)
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        table: filter
        chain: "{{ item }}"
        flush: true
        ip_version: ipv6
      loop:
        - INPUT
        - FORWARD
        - OUTPUT

    - name: Allow IPv6 loopback
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        in_interface: lo
        jump: ACCEPT
        ip_version: ipv6
        comment: "Allow IPv6 loopback"

    - name: Allow IPv6 established/related
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        ctstate: ESTABLISHED,RELATED
        jump: ACCEPT
        ip_version: ipv6
        comment: "Allow IPv6 established/related"

    - name: Reject all other IPv6 inbound traffic
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        jump: REJECT
        ip_version: ipv6
        comment: "Reject unrelated IPv6 inbound"

    - name: Ensure /etc/iptables directory exists for persisted rules
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/iptables
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Persist current IPv4 rules
      ansible.builtin.command: /usr/sbin/iptables-save -c
      register: iptables_save
      changed_when: false

    - name: Write persisted IPv4 rules file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: "{{ iptables_save.stdout }}\n"
        dest: /etc/iptables/rules-save
        mode: "0600"

    - name: Persist current IPv6 rules
      ansible.builtin.command: /usr/sbin/ip6tables-save -c
      register: ip6tables_save
      changed_when: false

    - name: Write persisted IPv6 rules file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        content: "{{ ip6tables_save.stdout }}\n"
        dest: /etc/iptables/rules6-save
        mode: "0600"

    - name: Enable iptables OpenRC service to restore rules on boot
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: iptables
        enabled: true

    - name: Enable ip6tables OpenRC service to restore rules on boot
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: ip6tables
        enabled: true

    - name: Start iptables OpenRC service (loads persisted rules, no-op if active)
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: iptables
        state: started

    - name: Start ip6tables OpenRC service (loads persisted rules, no-op if active)
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: ip6tables
        state: started
PLAYBOOK_EOF
